description: Fix 1 + Fix 2 (tightly coupled across the backend contract and the frontend): make the 'Why spend changed' tab offer only answerable month-pairs and show an honest banner. Surface the CUR's earliest_billing_period to the frontend and return a distinguishable HTTP 422 coverage reason (not the generic 409 'no CUR') when the report is readable but does not reach back two months, then thread that reason through the frontend instead of collapsing every non-OK response to null. This FEAT does NOT touch product_product_name (that is FEAT-002) and is independent of it; implement FEAT-001 first because it is the user-visible defect from the original report.
steps: Backend DTO (Fix 1): add `String earliestBillingPeriod` to the CurAdvancedMetricsService.ReportCapabilities record and populate it in getReportCapabilities(source, account) from source.getEarliestBillingPeriod() (pass null/blank through as-is). This reuses the existing /capabilities describe surface instead of a new endpoint. File: xamops-service/src/main/java/com/xammer/cloud/service/cur/CurAdvancedMetricsService.java.

Backend contract (Fix 2): in CurInsightsController.computePriceVsVolume(...), when curSourceResolver.resolve(...) is empty, obtain CurSourceResolver.Coverage via describeCoverage(account, prior.atDay(1), current.atEndOfMonth(), false). If coverage.reason() equals "RANGE_BEFORE_START", return HTTP 422 with body {"error": <short sentence>, "detail": coverage.message(), "reason": "RANGE_BEFORE_START", "earliestBillingPeriod": coverage.earliestBillingPeriod()} via a new private helper coverageUnanswerable(accountId, coverage) placed beside cannotAnswer(...)/noCurSource(...), using ResponseEntity.unprocessableEntity() and INFO logging. For every other empty reason keep noCurSource(accountId, coverage.message()) => 409. Leave the genuine missing-quantity path (ReportCannotAnswerException => cannotAnswer) untouched. File: xamops-service/src/main/java/com/xammer/cloud/controller/CurInsightsController.java.

Backend tests: in CurInsightsControllerTest update any new CurSourceResolver.Coverage(...) and ReportCapabilities(...) constructor calls to the new arity, and add priceVsVolumeIsFourTwentyTwoWhenReportStartsAfterTheEarlierMonth (resolve empty; describeCoverage returns Coverage(empty, "RANGE_BEFORE_START", "This report starts at 2026-09, which is after the start of the range you picked.", "2026-09", null); request priceVsVolume(ACCOUNT_ID, "2026-09"); assert 422, body reason=RANGE_BEFORE_START, earliestBillingPeriod=2026-09, detail carries the sentence). Keep noSourceExplainsTheActualLimit (reason STARTS_LATER) asserting 409. If CurAdvancedMetricsServiceTest constructs ReportCapabilities directly, fix the arity there too. Files: xamops-service/src/test/java/com/xammer/cloud/controller/CurInsightsControllerTest.java (and CurAdvancedMetricsServiceTest.java if needed).

Frontend API (Fix 2): in frontend-app/src/api/curInsightsApi.ts add `earliestBillingPeriod?: string` to the ReportCapabilities interface. Change ONLY fetchPriceVsVolume to stop collapsing every non-OK to bare null: on a 422 whose JSON body has reason === 'RANGE_BEFORE_START', return a discriminated value e.g. { unavailable: 'coverage', detail: body.detail, earliest: body.earliestBillingPeriod }; keep returning null for 409/other non-OK/unreadable-shape. Widen fetchPriceVsVolume's return type to PriceVolumeChange[] | { unavailable: 'coverage'; detail: string; earliest?: string } | null. Do NOT change the other fetchers or useCurInsight's generic signature. File: frontend-app/src/api/curInsightsApi.ts.

Frontend component (Fix 1 + Fix 2): in frontend-app/src/components/Cost/PriceVsVolumeSection.tsx: (a) treat the coverage result distinctly from null and render a coverage-specific sentence built from detail/earliest (e.g. 'This report starts at September 2026, so it can\'t compare August.') instead of the generic 'needs usage quantity alongside cost' banner; keep that generic banner ONLY for the true null (missing-quantity / no readable source) case; keep the empty-array 'No service moved by more than $1...' message unchanged. (b) make comparisonOptions() only offer pairs whose earlier month start >= earliestBillingPeriod and default the selector to the newest covered pair, fetching earliest via fetchReportCapabilities(accountId) on the default AWS path only (guard so GCP/Azure fetchers, which have no AWS capabilities endpoint, still render all pairs); when earliest is unknown, fall back to offering all 12 pairs. Preserve the fetcher-prop seam and the heading/tab behavior. File: frontend-app/src/components/Cost/PriceVsVolumeSection.tsx.
acceptance_criteria: `mvn -q -pl xamops-service test -Dtest=CurInsightsControllerTest,CurAdvancedMetricsServiceTest` passes, including the new 422 coverage test and the retained 409 STARTS_LATER test.

A price-vs-volume request whose earlier month precedes earliest_billing_period returns HTTP 422 with reason RANGE_BEFORE_START and earliestBillingPeriod in the body; genuinely no-CUR reasons still return 409.
`npm run build` in frontend-app typechecks (tsc) and builds, and `npm run test` passes.

The frontend renders a coverage-specific sentence (not the 'usage quantity' banner) for the coverage case, keeps the generic banner for the true missing-quantity case, and the month selector only offers answerable pairs defaulting to the newest covered one.
No change to the price/volume split math or the usage-quantity (line_item_usage_amount) query; other fetchPriceVsVolume/useCurInsight callers are unaffected.
verification: cd into the worktree root and run `mvn -q -pl xamops-service test -Dtest=CurInsightsControllerTest,CurAdvancedMetricsServiceTest`
cd into frontend-app and run `npm run build` then `npm run test`
findings:
IMPLEMENTED.

Backend record arity change (FEAT-002 and any other ReportCapabilities constructor callers must use the new arity): CurAdvancedMetricsService.ReportCapabilities now has SIX components, in order: (boolean amortizedAvailable, List<String> amortizedMissingColumns, boolean unitAvailable, String amortizedDetail, String unitDetail, String earliestBillingPeriod). The new trailing field is populated in getReportCapabilities(...) from source.getEarliestBillingPeriod() (null/blank passed through as-is). CurAdvancedMetricsServiceTest only reads fields, never constructs the record, so it needed no change; CurInsightsControllerTest constructs it twice and both now pass the 6th arg ('2026-01').

New controller helper: private ResponseEntity<Map<String,Object>> coverageUnanswerable(String accountId, CurSourceResolver.Coverage coverage), placed beside cannotAnswer(...)/noCurSource(...). Uses ResponseEntity.unprocessableEntity() (HTTP 422) and INFO logging. Built with a HashMap (NOT Map.of) because earliestBillingPeriod may be null and Map.of rejects null values.

Exact 422 body shape (for price-vs-volume coverage failure): {"error": "This report does not reach back far enough to compare those two months", "detail": <coverage.message()>, "reason": "RANGE_BEFORE_START", "earliestBillingPeriod": <coverage.earliestBillingPeriod(), may be null>}. Only computePriceVsVolume branches on coverage.reason().equals("RANGE_BEFORE_START") => coverageUnanswerable => 422; every other empty reason still => noCurSource => 409. runWithSource (the other 10 endpoints) and the ReportCannotAnswerException => cannotAnswer(...) 422 path are untouched.

Frontend API (curInsightsApi.ts): ReportCapabilities interface gained optional `earliestBillingPeriod?: string`. New exported interface PriceVolumeCoverageGap = { unavailable: 'coverage'; detail: string; earliest?: string }. fetchPriceVsVolume return type widened to Promise<PriceVolumeChange[] | PriceVolumeCoverageGap | null>; it now reads a 422 body and returns the coverage-gap object only when body.reason === 'RANGE_BEFORE_START' and body.detail is a string, else null (409/502/other/unreadable all stay null, unchanged). No other fetcher or useCurInsight signature changed.

Frontend component (PriceVsVolumeSection.tsx): comparisonOptions(earliest?) now filters to pairs whose EARLIER month (YYYY-MM string compare) >= earliest; unknown earliest => all 12 pairs; if filtering empties the list it keeps the single newest pair so the selector always has a valid selection (backend 422 then drives the coverage banner). earliest is fetched via fetchReportCapabilities(accountId) ONLY on the default AWS path, detected by `fetcher === fetchPriceVsVolume` (GCP/Azure custom fetchers skip the probe and get all pairs). A coverage-gap result renders a coverage-specific sentence (prefers 'This report starts at <Month YYYY>, so it can't compare <priorMonth>...' built from earliest, falls back to backend detail) and keeps the card even as a standalone section; the generic 'needs usage quantity' banner now shows ONLY for true null; the empty-array 'No service moved by more than $1' message is unchanged. Added exported type alias PriceVsVolumeResult and isCoverageGap() type guard, and a useEffect import.

Verification: `mvn -q -pl xamops-service test -Dtest=CurInsightsControllerTest,CurAdvancedMetricsServiceTest` passes (incl. new priceVsVolumeIsFourTwentyTwoWhenReportStartsAfterTheEarlierMonth and retained noSourceExplainsTheActualLimit STARTS_LATER=409). Frontend `npm run build` (tsc+vite) passes; `npm run test` has 7 pre-existing environmental failures (localStorage.setItem stub in ThemeContext, Sidebar/BillOpsAdminDashboard tests) that fail identically on the unmodified main checkout and are unrelated to this change; all 104 Cost + curInsightsApi tests pass.

BUILD-ENV NOTE for later steps: the worktree frontend-app had no node_modules and `npm ci` could not complete (registry ETIMEDOUT on the dompurify tarball). node_modules was populated by rsync from the main checkout (../../frontend-app/node_modules), whose lockfile is byte-identical. It is gitignored, so nothing was committed from it; dist/index.html and public/version.json were regenerated by the build and reverted before committing.
